reason: Kra pao and khai jiao are the first dishes my mum ever taught me, so I don't need an app to walk me through them, and since I only cook on Sundays, 3 free questions a day is already more than I'd ever use. There's nothing here worth 99 baht a month to me.
objection: I can watch a free video for this, or just call mum, and I trust her recipe more than an app. Paying every month to type more questions to an AI about dishes I already know feels like paying for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If the membership came with lots of dishes I could batch-cook on Sunday for the whole week, not just two I already know. More questions alone will never make me pay.
